name: Vicksburg Bridge
facts: The Vicksburg Bridge, a cantilever marvel, carries Interstate 20 and U.S. Route 80 across the mighty Mississippi, linking Delta, Louisiana to Vicksburg, Mississippi.
In 1998, when the Old Vicksburg Bridge shut its lanes to cars, U.S. Route 80 was rerouted over this new span, keeping commerce flowing.
By 2013, officials launched stability upgrades and installed underwater radar to shield the bridge from frequent barge collisions that plagued its history.
